thread:
Lina G.: Heads up — we just noticed a batch where NimbleCloud invoices were generated twice and one of the duplicates is missing the compute lineitems entirely. Customer reported missing GPU charges but higher support fee on both copies.
Raj Patel: Ugh. Any idea what the root is? :thinking_face:
Lina G.: Looks like the nightly invoice job retried after a transient DB timeout. Retry wrapper didn't clear temp rows so the second run re-used a partial staging table. The compute SKU mapping also changed name last week (reserved_gpu -> reserved_capacity_gpu) so those lines got filtered out by the lineitem mapper.
finance-bot: billing-job-processor: invoice-generation failed for batch 2026-03-20T02:00Z (timeout) — automatic retry scheduled in 30s
Sasha M.: I pushed a fix to the mapper earlier this morning that handles both SKU variants. Patch id: billing/mapper@a12f. Did the retry run before that? If so, that would explain the missing compute lines.
Lina G.: Yes retry ran at 02:01 and created inv_2026_NIMBLE_1002 and inv_2026_NIMBLE_1003. 1002 has full lines, 1003 is the duplicate missing compute and with support line doubled. I attached the invoice IDs to the ticket.
Eileen: How big is the exposure? Need to know before we send any credits.
Lina G.: Quick tally — customer was underbilled in one copy by ~$9,200 (missing compute) and the duplicate added a phantom support fee of $1,150 on the other. Net effect is customer sees two invoices totaling +$1,150 vs expected single invoice. We should void the incorrect duplicate and issue a corrected invoice + credit for the underbilled compute.
Raj Patel: Agreed. Steps:
1) Void inv_2026_NIMBLE_1003 (duplicate) — accounting approval needed.
2) Regenerate correct invoice and send to customer.
3) Post manual credit for $9,200 to cover missing compute line on the remaining invoice.
Can someone paste the quick SQL to identify all affected staging rows so we can ensure no more duplicates?
